title: SURPRISE CHOCOLATE CREAMS
instructions: Melt the fondant over hot water and add the flavoring. Put a bit of cherry in the bottom of each starch impression, then turn in the melted fondant, to fill the impressions and have them level on the top. Let the chocolate, broken in bits, be melted over warm water, then add as many chopped peanuts as can be well stirred into it; let cool to about 80&#176; F. and in it drop the creams, one at a time; as coated dispose them on table oil cloth or waxed paper.
